name: Rabies virus
short_description: A bullet-shaped rhabdovirus (Rabies lyssavirus, family Rhabdoviridae): ~180 nm long by ~75 nm wide (~2.4:1), hemispherically rounded at one end and flat/slightly concave at the other. G-glycoprotein spikes stud the rounded end and curved sides but are absent from the flat base; a matrix (M) protein layer lines the envelope; a helical, cross-striated ribonucleoprotein (negative-sense ssRNA + N/L/P proteins) fills the interior.
